name: Regular I Boot Right
purpose: Play action off the toss look. Two receivers to the SL side and a quarterback with the whole edge to himself. Run first, throw second.

RTE.rule: Bump the end, then release and settle at eight yards on the boot side.

SL.rule: Run to the flat at four yards in front of the quarterback. You are his easy throw.

QB.rule: Fake the toss, hide it on your back hip, run the edge. Throw only when they take you.

FB.sell: Run the toss path away from the boot. Block whatever shows.

TB.rule: Run the toss path away, arms tucked like you have it. Sell it to the sideline.

coaching_points: Our ends must engage their end before releasing — sell the run first, then get out.
Run first. At this age the quarterback usually walks into ten yards before anyone finds him.
No blitzing is allowed for 8- and 9-year-olds, so the quarterback has time. Teach him to be patient and look up.
One throw, then tuck it. No scrambling backwards, ever.
